svg.title: F32-2 Switching programme sheet as printed: SP-B1-HV-007 rev 1, steps 9 to 16
svg.text: SAP R. Nugroho / SAP A. Wibowo
SAP, assistant, CxM, OEM, Ahli K3
Stop rule printed on every page

If the actual indication differs from the expected indication, the SAP stops, makes the equipment safe in its current state and calls the control person. No step is added or changed without a written revision.
Programme timing: 24 steps at 2 to 4 minutes each with read-back, about 75 minutes plus hold points, inside the 4-hour window.
F32-2 Switching programme sheet as printed: SP-B1-HV-007 rev 1, steps 9 to 16
First energisation of 20 kV ring R1, building B1 · window 2 Nov 2026 09:00 to 13:00 · 24 steps, 3 hold points · charging current at step 11 expected near 1 A
• Steps 10 and 16 are hold points where the control person gives permission and the time is recorded.
• Step 11 reads 1.1 A against an expected 0 A to 2 A; a reading of tens of amperes would mean a fault or a closed tee-off, and the SAP stops.
